purpose: Tools this repository invokes but does not hold. Recorded so that 'the battery was green' names the versions that produced it; a green run against unrecorded tooling is not a reproducible claim.
why_no_digest: A sha256 of /usr/bin/git identifies one machine's build, not a version, so recording one would report drift on every machine that is not this one. Vendored tools are different and ARE digest-pinned: see cue-tool.v1.json, where we hold the binary and can hold it to a hash. artifacts/instance/tools/harness-identity.py takes a digest at preflight for the run at hand, which is the right scope for one.
not_enforced: artifacts/instance/tools/pin-check.py reports drift; nothing fails a build on it. This is data and a check, not a gate invariant — the gate is at 6/6 and no incident here has occurred. Promoting it costs a deletion or a deliberate cap raise, and that is the right price.

gh.used_for: pull requests, the releases API in pin-check.py, and auth at the arm gate

git.used_for: everything; also the hooks in ops/hooks, which need core.hooksPath (git >= 2.9)

python3.used_for: the kernel and every tool. pyproject.toml requires >= 3.12; tomllib is why

serena.used_for: dev-lane symbolic navigation. A .dev0 build is not a release, so the recorded value pins nothing upstream can confirm — replace it with a release version when one is installed
